message:
Today, we took a little moment to check on our emergency supplies. It’s kind of comforting to know we have a cozy little stash tucked away, ready for anything that might come our way. 🏠

We like to think of it as our ‘just in case’ corner, a reminder that we can handle surprises together. How about you? Do you have a favorite spot for your essentials?
scene: a labelled bin of emergency supplies on a closet shelf (just after cleanup, everything tidy)
